fact: On 2 April 2025 the Western Africa Regional Digital Integration Program (WARDIP) was launched in Bissau, with a steering committee, a technical committee of digital economy focal points and a project implementation unit under the transport and telecommunications ministry.
title: Sob os auspícios do governo: PROJETO WARDIP LANÇADO EM BISSAU PARA APOIAR A TRANSFORMAÇÃO DIGITAL E IMPULSIONAR A ECONOMIA
